transcript.text: I need to flag an important update. Yesterday I confirmed with the performers' union office that the festival's agreement actually requires a $75 paid audition fee and limits each prepared audition side to exactly five minutes. This addendum arrived after the current draft of the casting call was circulated, and it hasn't yet been entered in the casting file. So the draft as it stands — with ten-minute sides and no specified audition fee — is not in compliance with our union agreement.
